# Credits

## Music and sound

**Music and sound: composed and generated by Claude for Hands of God.**

- All music (the hand motif, the Era 1 adaptive piece "First Fire", the Era 2
  adaptive piece "Long Furrows", the Era 3 adaptive piece "Market Bells", the
  stingers including the Era 2 and Era 3 arrivals, the title theme, the
  Badlandsrise studio sting and the intro underscore) was
  composed as MIDI by Claude (`tools/music/`) and rendered with FluidSynth.
- All sound effects and the villager voices were synthesised procedurally
  with numpy by Claude (`tools/music/sfx.py`, `tools/music/voices.py`).

### Soundfont

- **FluidR3_GM** General MIDI soundfont by Frank Wen, released under the
  MIT licence. Used to render the music.

## Studio

**Badlandsrise Game Studio.** The studio splash (emblem, wordmark and sting) was
designed and built in-engine for Hands of God by Claude (`scripts/front/`,
`tools/music/front.py`).

## Art

All third-party art is CC0 (public domain dedication); credit is given anyway. Hand-built props,
shaders and the placeholder animals are made for this project.

| Pack | Author | Licence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ultimate Nature Pack | Quaternius | CC0 | https://quaternius.itch.io/150-lowpoly-nature-models (quaternius.com/packs/ultimatenature.html) |
| Medieval Village MegaKit (Standard) | Quaternius | CC0 | https://quaternius.itch.io/medieval-village-megakit |
| Universal Base Characters (Standard) | Quaternius | CC0 | https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-base-characters |
| Universal Animation Library (Standard) | Quaternius | CC0 | https://quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library |
| Farm Animals (Animated) | Quaternius | CC0 | https://quaternius.itch.io/lowpoly-animated-animals (quaternius.com/packs/farmanimal.html) |
| Survival Kit | Kenney (www.kenney.nl) | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/survival-kit |
| Pirate Kit (row boats, ships, crates) | Kenney (www.kenney.nl) | CC0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/pirate-kit |
| Hand models and hand poses (godot-xr-tools) | Miodrag Sejic (DigitalN8m4r3), GodotVR/godot-xr-tools | CC0 | https://github.com/GodotVR/godot-xr-tools |

The hand is a white cartoon glove modelled for Hands of God on the CC0 godot-xr-tools
base hand (Hand_low_R) by Miodrag Sejic, keeping its OpenXR skeleton and poses
(`assets/models/hand/`).

The Era 2 (Village) kit was made for Hands of God: its buildings, construction stages, fields,
piles, tools, carts, stalls and the temple are modelled in code (`scripts/assets/tools/build_era2.gd`)
around CC0 pieces from the Medieval Village MegaKit (plaster walls, doors, shutters, chimney),
the Survival Kit (workbenches, barrels, crates), the Pirate Kit (row boats), Farm Animals (cow,
pig) and the Ultimate Nature Pack (rocks). The thatch, plank and daub textures
(`assets/textures/era2/`) are procedural, painted by `scripts/assets/tools/gen_era2_textures.py`.

The Era 3 (Town) kit was also made for Hands of God. Its townhouses, great hall, civic buildings,
workshops, harbour, lighthouse, aqueduct, streets, carts, piles and tools are modelled in code
(`scripts/assets/tools/build_era3.gd`) around CC0 pieces from the Medieval Village MegaKit (brick
and stone walls, glazed windows, doors, round-tile roof pieces, balconies, dormer, chimney,
wagon), the Pirate Kit (the two sailing ships and cargo crates) and the Survival Kit (barrels,
anvil, tools). The slate, cobble, stained-glass, clock-face, flag and book textures
(`assets/textures/era3/`) are procedural, painted by `scripts/assets/tools/gen_era3_textures.py`.

## Ground textures

The ground ships three looks (`scripts/world/ground_look.gd`); the default is the
photo set, posterised, softened and tinted toward the palette in the terrain shader.
All are CC0 1.0; credit is given anyway.

| Layer | Look | Texture | Author / site | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Grass | photo | Grass004 | ambientCG | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Grass004 |
| Rock | photo | Rock058 | ambientCG | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Rock058 |
| Dirt | photo | dirt_floor | Poly Haven | https://polyhaven.com/a/dirt_floor |
| Mud | photo | brown_mud_03 | Poly Haven | https://polyhaven.com/a/brown_mud_03 |
| Forest floor | photo | leaves_forest_ground | Poly Haven | https://polyhaven.com/a/leaves_forest_ground |
| Grass | stylised | Handpainted grass texture pack (grass_01b) | OpenGameArt contributor | https://opengameart.org/content/handpainted-grass-texture-pack |
| Rock | stylised | Handpainted rock textures (hptex pack 4, rock_03) | OpenGameArt contributor | https://opengameart.org/content/handpainted-rock-textures |
| Dirt, mud, forest floor | stylised | Tileable dirt textures (Dirt_01, 02, 04) | OpenGameArt contributor | https://opengameart.org/content/tileable-dirt-textures |

The OpenGameArt pages did not name their authors in what was fetched; see each page.
